# Documentation Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that documentation requirements are complete and that documentation-behavior consistency is enforceable.
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [ADRs](../../../docs/adr/README.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Item tags**: `[Mandatory]` means the criterion derives from the constitution, an approved requirement, or an accepted ADR or ruling. `[Optional]` means it concerns an enhancement. `[Dnn]` refers to a detection from the checklist brief; the detection map is in [../gates/release-evidence-gates.md](../gates/release-evidence-gates.md). Post-implementation evidence checks are in that gates file, not here. Every item is unchecked, including `[Optional]` items, so `/speckit-implement` reports this file as incomplete until a reviewer marks it.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the required deliverable documents enumerated (setup, architecture overview, testing approach, limitations, trade-offs)? [Completeness, Spec §CST-003] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the documentation set specified with file locations (README, architecture, threat model, testing, limitations, release readiness, traceability)? [Completeness, Plan §Project Structure] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the limitations document required to list every backlog item (BL-01 to BL-12) and every accepted residual risk? [Completeness, Plan §14.1; ADRs] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the final engineering summary content enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-ORC-026] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the rule that the confidential assessment source is never committed, and is referenced by section only, stated? [Completeness, CON X; Spec §CST-004] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is the rule "documentation evolves in the same change set as the code" stated together with a way to detect violations? [Gap, CON X] [D30] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the docs-accuracy mechanism specified measurably (an automated quickstart test plus a recorded release-review comparison of docs against observed behavior)? [Measurability, Spec §NFR-DOC-001 (CR-003); Plan §13] [D30] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK008 Is it required that illustrative examples are labeled as not being evidence? [Clarity, CON X; contracts/examples] [D23] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the quickstart required to distinguish executed commands from planned ones until the automated quickstart test validates them? [Clarity, Spec §NFR-DOC-001 (CR-003); quickstart.md status] [D23] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the reviewer setup-time target quantified, together with how it is measured? [Measurability, PVT-009] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK011 Are documents required to carry `satisfies:` front matter for traceability? [Traceability, Plan §13] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Are architecture descriptions and diagrams required to match the accepted ADRs (for example, the process topology in ADR-004)? [Consistency, ADR-004] [D25] [Optional]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- `[Gap]` = the requirement is missing; `[Ambiguity]` = the term or rule needs a definition; `[Conflict]` = two sources disagree; `[Assumption]` = relies on an unvalidated assumption
